title: Biggest hack in history: Cryptocurrency giant Binance loses $6.3 billion
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange giant Binance has been targeted by a record-breaking $6.3 billion cyber heist, with blockchain intelligence firms linking the attack to North Korea.
